summary: A newcomer can say whether they came to knock doors, seek a precinct job or serve as a delegate.
realLife: At its February 2026 meeting the 31st District invited optional introductions; newcomers described interest in convention service, precinct office and canvassing.
inGame: needs: voluntary introduction and expressed interest.

turns.pulledBy: The newcomer chooses a kind of work.
turns.what: An organizer offers the corresponding contact.
turns.writesBack: The first assignment follows the volunteer's own interest.

turns.what: The chair moves on without assigning a role.
turns.writesBack: Attendance alone does not put a name on the work list.
